About Me

Hi Brands!

  • Your product deserves content that feels beautiful, natural, and scroll-stopping - not forced or overly staged. I help beauty brands show their products in a way that feels easy to watch, easy to understand, and easy to trust.
  • I am a Los Angeles-based UGC creator with 1 year of experience in beauty, skincare, and haircare content. I’ve created 70+ videos and photos for brands, focusing on product details, real application, natural results, and content that feels both organic and ad-ready.
  • My visual style is warm, feminine, sunkissed, and beauty-focused with soft brown, buttermilk, beige, white, and pink tones, glossy beauty details, natural light, gold accents, and clean lifestyle settings.
